name: Loom
whatYouLose: Instant share links while the video is still uploading
Transcoding, adaptive streaming and a CDN
Desktop recorder with camera bubble, drawing and trimming
Viewer analytics, comments and reactions inside your company workspace
prompt:
Build a browser-based screen recorder with share links, a minimal Loom alternative.

Stack: Vite + vanilla TS, MediaRecorder + getDisplayMedia, Node + Hono backend, files on disk or S3-compatible storage, ffmpeg for transcoding.
Features:
- Record screen + mic + optional camera bubble composited on a canvas.
- Upload in chunks while recording; on stop, ffmpeg produces an MP4 and a thumbnail.
- Share page /v/:id with player, title, view count and timestamped comments.
- Whisper-based transcript (local or API) shown under the video.
- Trim start/end before publishing.
Done when: a 1-minute recording uploads and plays back from a share link in another browser.
notes: Recording in the browser is easy. Instant links, streaming infrastructure and the desktop app experience are not one prompt.
